0B11.name: 速報馬体重
0B11.timing: around 1 hour before post; added/updated when bodyweight is announced

0B14_or_0B16.name: 速報開催情報 一括/指定
0B14_or_0B16.update_behavior: added/updated/deleted whenever event information occurs or changes

retrieval.bulk_change_info: JVRTOpen dataspec 0B14 with key YYYYMMDD, then repeat JVRead
retrieval.event_mode: JVWatchEvent can push jockey/weather/course/avoid/time/weight events; use event parameter as key for JVRTOpen when per-event retrieval is desired
retrieval.platform_constraint: JV-Link is Windows ActiveX COM; local Windows execution is required

gate_implication.important: The previous final-state JVD file remains forbidden for current-race features. These official realtime feeds are a separate source class and may unlock current features only after a real capture is hashed and their announcement/source time is proven <= the prediction snapshot.
gate_implication.historical_limitation: 0B11/0B14 availability is short-lived (about one week in the spec). This does not retroactively repair historical DEV provenance; forward capture is required.
